assessments.reasoning: The survey does not record unpaid domestic or care work for each person through dedicated questions or time-use measurements. Domestic work and care responsibilities appear only as categories of inactivity ('Dedicado a las labores del hogar') or as reasons for working part-time, being absent, or not seeking work ('Responsabilidades de cuidado de hijos u otros familiares'). According to the indicator criteria, mentioning domestic work only as a category of inactivity or a reason for not working does not satisfy the requirement.
